title: CLCON/114/2014 of Hukam Singh Negi Vs S.raju AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
CLCON No. 114 of 2014
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Heard Mr. Ashutosh Posti, Advocate holding brief
Mr. S.K. Posti and Mr. Pradeep Hariya, learned Standing
Counsel for the opposite parties.
Writ petition (S/S) No. 1069 of 2013 filed by the
petitioner was allowed by writ court vide judgment and
order dated 20.12.2013. Operative portion of the said
judgment is extracted below:-
"That being so, it can safely be concluded that pay
scale of Head Clerk, Senior Assistant or Chief Assistant was
` 4500-125-7000, which has now been increased to `
5000-150- 8000 and posts are re-designated as
Administrative Officer Grade II, therefore, in my considered
opinion, petitioner is entitled for enhanced pay scale of `
5000-150- 8000 and denial to grant benefit of Government
Order dated 03.06.2006 cannot be said to be justified,
consequently, writ petition is allowed. Impugned order
dated 19.06.2007 is hereby quashed. Respondents are
directed to grant pay scale of ` 5000-150- 8000 to the
petitioner and to calculate the arrears and release the
amount arrears in favour of the petitioner within 90 days
from today and if arrears are not paid within 90 days from
today, respondents shall pay interest @ 12% per annum on
the amount of arrears from the date of passing of this
judgment till the actual payment is made. No order as to
costs."
Special Appeal and SLP filed by the State of
Uttarakhand were dismissed, thus, the said judgment
attained finality.
In this contempt petition, petitioner has alleged
that opposite parties have willfully violated the order of
this Court. A compliance affidavit has been filed by Dr.
Ranbir Singh, Additional Chief Secretary, Government of
Uttarakhand. Para 5 and 8 of the said affidavit are
extracted below:-
"9. That at present the order dated 20.12.2013 has been
fully complied as the payment which was to be made to the
petitioner is of actual amount of Rs. 4,43,620.00 as earlier a
tentative amount was calculated of Rs. 4,78,949.00 (which
was wrongly calculated). The said amount of Rs.
4,43,620.00 has duly paid in compliance of the Hon'ble
Court order dated 20.12.2013 and here it is relevant to
point out that as per the Hon'ble Court order dated
20.12.2013 it was also directed to pay interest # 12% per
annum this amount is Rs. 95,977, which will be paid as soon
as budget is received as for this amount special budget is
sanctioned for which process is under consideration as
letter for sanctioning the interest amount of Rs. 95,977 has
been forwarded to Secretary, School Education at present
and thereafter it will be sent to Finance Department and
after the approval of Finance Department the same amount
of

2
interest will be paid to the petitioner at the earliest. For
kind perusal of this Hon'ble Court the receipts of the
payment of Rs. 4,43,620.00 and also letter dated 7.7.2017 to
the Secretary, School Education by Additional Director,
Elementary Education for sanctioning the interest amount
of Rs. 95,977 is being filed herewith and marked as
Annexure No. 1 to this affidavit."
Mr. Pradeep Hariya, learned Standing Counsel
for the opposite parties submits that the Principal
amount as well as amount of interest has been paid to
the petitioner, therefore, the order of this Court has
been complied with in its letter and spirit.
In such view of the matter, it is not a case of
willful disobedience of the order of this Court.
Accordingly, contempt petition is dismissed.
Notice issued to the opposite party is hereby discharged.
However, liberty is reserved to the petitioner to seek
recall of this order, if the statement made on behalf of
opposite parties is found to be incorrect.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
Aswal 04.07.2019
